system.description: You pull a creature of level 3 or lower to you across almost any distance. You can choose a kind of creature that you've already encountered, or (once between each ten-hour recovery) you can let the GM randomly determine what creature appears. The creature appears next to you. They have no memory of anything before being called by you, but they have the general knowledge of a typical creature of their type. The creature is open to communicating and helping you. Action. Random Creature d20 Results 1–16 Level 3 17–18 Level 4 19–20 Level 5
